newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mixed, gas oil eases.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mixed, gas oil eases.

text.p: NWE oil products were mainly steady, although gas oil dipped after benchmark futures eased.
Gasoline was steady and the U.S. arbitrage window is now firmly shut.
Naphtha was steady with demand seen good for n+a material. Paraffinic prices were weaker.
Gas oil was steady to slightly lower as benchmark futures eased on profit-taking. Traders said the physical side was firm.
Fuel oil barges gained about $1, taking early support from crude's rally. The EdP tender went to one trader at around fob mean NWE, fob mean Med +$10.60 cif Portugal.+44 171 542 7714.
